title: Identify European Firaga signed halfword readers
changes: Identify two signed-halfword readers whose physical views match 24 bytes in the Firaga residual sample.
validation: Protected pointer scan e347-firaga-14cf-pointer-xrefs-zh94vzfa and retained Wine disassembly e336-firaga-residual-literals-disassembly-wine-d9ijk6ak identify the base, second-view displacement and six matching indices.
limitations: The address-only sample does not attribute executing PCs. A full source plan and runtime publication, other readers/scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
